title: Mold Remediation Signing Deposit Amount
content:
**Rule.** The signing deposit on a Mold Remediation job is the tier's self-pay deposit plus the total of every charge line booked on the job when the agreement is signed, less the customer payments already posted to the job, rounded to the cent, half up.

**Assembly of the figure.** A credit against the deposit is subtracted from the tier's self-pay deposit first, and that difference is never below 0.00; every raise or prepayment on the deposit is then added, the booked charge lines are added and the customer payments already posted are subtracted; the result is never below 0.00 and is rounded once to the cent, half up.

**Company warranty jobs.** A company warranty job pays no signing deposit.

## The quantities

| Quantity | Read from |
|---|---|
| Tier's self-pay deposit | The Mold Remediation deposit and payment terms figures for the job's tier |
| Booked charge lines | Every charge line on the job at the moment the agreement is signed |
| Customer payments already posted | The customer payments on the job; insurance postings and credits are not customer payments |

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

1. Tier deposit 820.00, charge lines booked on the job 655.40, no customer payments: 820.00 plus 655.40 is 1475.40.
2. Tier deposit 820.00, no charge lines, customer payments already posted 300.00: 820.00 less 300.00 is 520.00.
3. Tier deposit 820.00, no charge lines, customer payments already posted 1000.00: the result would fall below zero, so the deposit is 0.00.
4. A company warranty job: 0.00.
